643-1168-3510-8168.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-1168-3510-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

3234-3293-5413-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5413-8095.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5413-8095.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1170-3375-5131-6798--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3375-5131-6798--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to The Immortal Sun.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

1315-1671-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Repeat.

4067-5042-6480-7824.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
4067-5042-6480-7824.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Rescue Leopard.
Rescue Leopard triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Rescue Leopard.
Repeat.

813-4377-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Scholar of the Ages.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Scholar of the Ages from exile to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4399-4770-5998-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
4399-4770-5998-6458.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Thunder of Unity trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5998-6458.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

2292-3234-3946-7776.description:
While Glacial Chasm is on the battlefield, all damage that would be dealt to you is prevented.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, returning Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Glacial Chasm and Mortuary Mire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Glacial Chasm trigger, sacrificing Mortuary Mire.
Resolve the Mortuary Mire trigger, putting World Shaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 3.
Move to your next turn, drawing World Shaper during your draw step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Glacial Chasm triggers. Choose not to pay its cumulative upkeep cost and sacrifice it.
Cast World Shaper by paying {3}{G}.
Repeat from step 3.
2292-3234-3946-7776.notes: If your life total allows, you can instead opt to pay Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep cost. If you do this, you can forego doing this loop during that turn.

2511-6258--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat

2646-4050--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Repeat.

3542-3647-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
3542-3647-7487.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Zealous Lorecaster and Palinchron
When Zealous Lorecaster and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
3542-3647-7487.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

57-206-3094-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-206-3094-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements

112-7117.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {0} due to Aang's cost reduction, returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat.

261-2034-3490-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-2034-3490-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

539-5413-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat from step 3.

141-2511-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2511-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

67-1676-3330-5670-6917.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-3330-5670-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Leyline of Vitality and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Leyline of Vitality triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-3330-5670-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

2173-5220-5231-6538.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

372-2974-5895.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Splash Portal.
372-2974-5895.description:
Cast Splash Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Splash Portal.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Splash Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

112-698-3152.easyPrerequisites: Will, Scion of Peace does not have summoning sickness.
112-698-3152.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained 3 or more life this turn.
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
112-698-3152.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast this turn to cost at least {3} less.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Repeat from step 2.

4053-5066--73.notablePrerequisites:
If a persist creature is used, it does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
Otherwise, if an undying creature is used, it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Fallen Ideal attached to a creature you control other than the persist or undying creature.
4053-5066--73.description:
Activate Fallen Ideal by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Fallen Ideal ability, giving the creature it is attached to +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1491-2445-6006-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2445-6006-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2445-6006-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

465-3480-3742-4251-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3480-3742-4251-4452.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2557-2793-3743-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
392-2557-2793-3743-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Harnfel by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

2921-4493-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
You have enough mana to cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication
2921-4493-5365.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Lonis that isn't legendary.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.
2921-4493-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

222-527-2079-2292.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2079-2292.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1165-2861-5541.notablePrerequisites:
Archfiend of the Dross has no more than four oil counters on it.
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
1165-2861-5541.description:
Cast Heartless Act by paying {1}{B}, removing up to three oil counters from Archfiend of the Dross.
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Archfiend of the Dross to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's next upkeep, Archfiend of the Dross triggers, causing the opponent to remove an oil counter from it and lose the game.

1744-4071.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have a collective life total of 150 or less, or your deck size is equal to or greater than 5 times the number of Demons you control and your life total is equal to or greater than that number plus one.
1744-4071.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Be'lakor.
Put all the Be'lakor tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Be'lakor token's first ability triggers, the nontoken Be'lakor's second ability triggers five times, and each Be'lakor token's second ability triggers four times.
Resolve the nontoken Be'lakor triggers, dealing 30 damage to up to 5 targets.
Resolve all the Be'lakor tokens' second abilities, dealing 120 damage to up to 20 targets.
If needed, resolve all the Be'lakor tokens' first abilities, causing you to draw five cards for each Demon you control and lose that much life.

692-4050-4613-5086.notablePrerequisites: Wildwood Mentor has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
692-4050-4613-5086.description:
Activate Wildwood Mentor using Triskelavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
When the Triskelavite enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Triskelavite, adding {1}.
Repeat.

678-2366-2882-3819-5256.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cultivator Colossus.
678-2366-2882-3819-5256.description:
Play Dryad Arbor from your hand.
Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield as a copy of Cultivator Colossus due to Infinite Reflection.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Dryad Arbor to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dryad Arbor's power.
Resolve the Dryad Arbor trigger from step 3, causing you to put Dryad Arbor onto the battlefield from your hand, draw a card, and then decline to put another land onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2341-2696.notablePrerequisites: You control a land and/or a creature or artifact that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}.
2341-2696.description:
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Holding priority, activate the mana-producing permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Teferi's ability.
Resolve the copy of Teferi's ability, untapping The Peregrine Dynamo and the mana producing artifact/land, and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat from step 2.

1571-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Blightsteel Colossus.
Blightsteel Colossus does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents are unable to block and kill your creatures.
1571-3851.description:
Declare Blightsteel Colossus as an attacker.
Blightsteel Colossus' myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of itself attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with each Blightsteel Colossus, giving each opponent eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

141-3047-4050.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1378-1872-2011.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
Mirage Phalanx is paired with Composite Golem.
Opponents can not block and kill Najeela.
1378-1872-2011.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Composte Golem and Mirage Phalanx trigger, creating copies of themselves with haste and without soulbond.
Attack with Najeela.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures you control, giving them haste, trample and lifelink and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Pass to the next combat phase.
Repeat.

6-4832-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Ensoul Artifact is attached to Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
6-4832-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-4832-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat
